# Amplifier Module Tool Bash

Shell command execution for Amplifier agents.

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11+
- Part of the Amplifier framework ecosystem

## Development
```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
python -m pytest
```

## Structure
This is an Amplifier tool module that provides Bash command execution.
